title: Interactive user interrogation system ('question' / 'ask_user' tool) with OpenCode-style prompt card and zero-polling Tokio pause
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented interactive user prompt tool ('question' / 'ask_user') allowing agents to ask clarifying questions with predefined options and custom user input. Backend pauses using tokio::sync::oneshot channel with 0% CPU and zero polling. Frontend renders tactile OpenCode-styled question cards in White Paper aesthetic.
